_comment: LIVE CONFIG. The sig in flowUrl IS the credential - do not commit or share this file. Regenerate the trigger URL when the PoC is over.
_emptyDeadband: Confirmed non-zero decks on these bridges, and 1701 read -20 on an empty one. 100 kg is the starting point; raise it if the dry run shows OCCUPIED with no truck present.
_settle: Send only after every reading for settleSeconds stays within settleTolerance (kg), and wx0131 reads not-moving. 2026-09-15: the old 3-read rule sent 9020 for a truck that stood at 13700.
_corrections: 2026-09-16: the gate office writes down the weight AFTER the driver climbs out (~80 kg). While a truck is on the deck the agent watches port 8000; a new weight held for updateSteadySeconds is re-read on 1701 and posted again with a higher sequence. A DROP over changeThreshold is the driver getting out. A RISE must exceed majorIncreaseKg to count, so the driver climbing back in is ignored. The flow must keep the LATEST sequence per truck.
_stuckCapturedMinutes: Shout if a deck stays latched this long without clearing. A bridge that never reads empty captures once and then goes silent, which looks exactly like a quiet day.
_streamWeightField: Field 1 of '10  22940  00'. Confirmed on real hardware 2026-09-10 - it tracked 22940, 37240 and 45440 on JV Scale IN.
_terminals: crce2_gate: 832200001 = jv scale, 832200000 = south. crce2_bounded: 832200000 = In, 832200001 = Out. The two columns are ordered OPPOSITE to each other.
_terminals_swapped: 2026-09-16, Bahra: the two JV addresses were the wrong way round. .51 is the OUT scale and .52 is the IN scale. Readings before this date carry the opposite direction.
_south_gate_in: 192.168.174.11 omitted - both ports closed and no ping response on 2026-09-10. Add back once Bahra confirms it is powered and networked: { "name": "South Gate IN", "host": "192.168.174.11", "gate": 832200000, "direction": 832200000 }
